name: Reverse Plank
steps: Sit with your legs straight and plant your palms behind your hips, fingers facing your feet or slightly out.
Press through your palms and heels to lift your hips high until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to ankles.
Squeeze your glutes, brace your core, and open your chest with your shoulders pulled back.
Hold the line while breathing evenly, then lower your hips to the floor.
tips: Keep your head aligned with your spine instead of dropping it far backward or tucking your chin down.
Do not let your hips sag toward the floor; keep your glutes and hamstrings engaged continuously.
